title: Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly Upgrade Charge — Calculation Sheet
content:
# Plus Monthly upgrade charge — calculation sheet (Wayfare Pass)

**Definition.** The Plus Monthly upgrade charge of a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership moving up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly is the Plus Monthly membership fee of 19.99 less the unused-period credit. The unused-period credit is the membership fees collected for the billing period in force less any fee refunds booked against them, multiplied by the days from the change date through the last day of the period, both days counted, over the days in the period, both end days counted, and rounded half up to the cent. The charge is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Inputs and records

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| Fees collected for the period in force | Membership fee charges on the membership ledger for the period that began on the membership's current period start |
| Fee refunds booked against them | Fee refunds on the membership ledger for that same period |
| Days remaining | From the change date through the last day of the current period, both counted |
| Days in the period | From the current period start through its last day, both counted |

The collected fees less refunds are taken as no less than 0.00.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

1. Wayfare Pass Monthly, period 1 June to 30 June (30 days), 9.99 collected for it and nothing refunded, move on 21 June. Days 21 to 30 June are 10; 9.99 multiplied by 10 and divided by 30 is 3.33, the unused-period credit. The charge is 19.99 less 3.33, that is 16.66.
2. Wayfare Pass Student, period 5 June to 4 July (30 days), 4.99 collected, move on 5 June. All 30 days remain, so the unused-period credit is 4.99 and the charge is 15.00.
3. A membership with 96.00 collected for a 365-day period and 260 days remaining: the unused-period credit is 68.38, more than 19.99, so the charge is 0.00.
